Ghostscript — PostScript/PDF interpreter (used on the SHARING PC to print jobs)
==============================================================================

PLACEHOLDER — binaries are NOT committed. Add them before building the installer.

What to add here (minimal redistributable subset is fine):
  third_party/ghostscript/bin/gswin64c.exe   (64-bit console binary — used by the app)
  third_party/ghostscript/bin/gswin32c.exe   (32-bit console binary — optional)
  third_party/ghostscript/bin/gsdll64.dll
  third_party/ghostscript/lib/*              (Ghostscript library files)

The app resolves: {InstallDir}\ghostscript\bin\gswin64c.exe

Source / license:
  Ghostscript is dual-licensed (AGPL or commercial). For private use on your own
  LAN the AGPL build is fine. If you ever distribute/sell PrintBridge, review the
  AGPL obligations or obtain a commercial Ghostscript license (Artifex).
  https://www.ghostscript.com/

Sanity check after adding:
  third_party\ghostscript\bin\gswin64c.exe -h     (should print Ghostscript help)
